items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Because Dukey Chase had a band and we wanted to be as good a band as Dukey Chase, because we were the number two band... But he had the better players and all. But he had a good band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he and I were in Booker T. Washington's band, and we made up, all of Booker T. Washington's band made up a swing band. We got Hogan, he was dead, a drummer. He didn't have a set of drums. He had to borrow a bass drum from somebody, and he had a snare drum, stands. And I had alto sax and another guy named Fuzzy, he was playing alto, he was in the band also. Who's that? Melvin Lastic. Louis Sergin is his name, he's not in New Orleans now, he went to California. But he and I played alto sax. Joe Jones was…
And you could play by ear though?
